title: Add installer docs for Terraform VPC module integration + improve network preflight errors
author: Kira Thompson
release_notes:
- Docs: add Terraform VPC modules integration guide and troubleshooting links (alpha).
- Installer: clearer preflight error text for missing ECR endpoints / Private DNS misconfigurations.
body:
## Why
During design partner pilots we keep losing time to “is this VPC wired correctly?” ambiguity. We now have an alpha set of Terraform VPC modules in `redwood-terraform`, but the installer docs do not explain:
- what outputs the installer expects / how to map module outputs to installer config
- which VPC endpoints + DNS settings are required for private-only installs
- how to interpret common failure modes (image pull failures, intermittent DNS)

This PR adds an explicit integration doc page in the installer repo, links out to the Terraform module suite, and tightens up a couple of preflight error messages so that support/SE can triage faster.

## What changed
### Docs
- Added a new guide: `docs/terraform-vpc-modules-integration.md`
  - Minimal “happy path” example wiring Terraform outputs into the installer config
  - Required endpoints list for fully-private installs (no public egress): ECR (api + dkr), S3 (gateway), STS, CloudWatch Logs (if log shipping), EC2 (for some bootstrap flows), KMS (if using CMKs), and optional endpoints called out
  - DNS notes: Private DNS behavior for interface endpoints, VPC resolver settings, and the most common pitfall (endpoint exists but private DNS disabled)
  - Connectivity notes: placeholders for VPN/DX; explicitly out-of-scope for alpha to auto-configure
- Updated `README.md` and `docs/troubleshooting.md` to link to the new guide and call out the alpha status + version pinning recommendation for modules.

### Installer messaging
- Updated the missing-endpoint preflight error copy to include:
  - the exact AWS endpoint(s) we detected as missing
  - the common remediation (“enable interface endpoint + enable Private DNS”)
  - a link to the new docs page
- Added a troubleshooting hint for intermittent DNS resolution that points to VPC resolver / DHCP options + CoreDNS forwarders.

## How to test
1) `make docs-lint` (markdown + link checker)
2) Run installer preflight against a VPC with ECR endpoints intentionally missing:
   - Expect: preflight fails with actionable error + docs link
3) Run preflight against a VPC with ECR endpoints present but Private DNS disabled:
   - Expect: preflight warns/fails with “endpoint present but Private DNS disabled” guidance (best-effort detection).

## Notes / scope
- This does not change the underlying endpoint detection logic (that’s in #19110); this PR focuses on documentation and making the failure text actionable.
- We intentionally do not prescribe a single subnet topology beyond “private subnets with route to NAT or endpoints”; the reference Terraform modules are the opinionated path.

## References
- SUP-28411 (installer fails pulling images due to missing ECR endpoints / Private DNS)
- SUP-28458 (intermittent DNS in private subnets during pilot)
- Linear ENG-4869 (align installer preflight checks with VPC module defaults)

## Checklist
- [x] Docs labeled as alpha and link to module repo + release notes
- [x] Added troubleshooting section for endpoints + DNS
- [x] Ran docs lint/link check in CI
- [x] Reviewed by Infra/Networking + Security
commits: docs(installer): add Terraform VPC modules integration guide (alpha)
docs(troubleshooting): document endpoint + DNS failure modes seen in pilots
installer(preflight): improve missing ECR endpoint error messaging + add docs link
conversation: Victor Alvarez (review): The endpoint list looks right, but can we call out that S3 should be gateway endpoint for most customers? Also specify ECR requires both api + dkr. We’ve had confusion here.

Kira Thompson (author): Good call. Updated the required list to explicitly list ECR (api + dkr) and noted S3 gateway endpoint as the default recommendation. Also added a short note about interface endpoints vs gateway endpoints and why S3 is special.

Nina Petrova (review): The guide mentions “private subnets only” but doesn’t state that the installer needs outbound access to AWS services either via endpoints or NAT. Can we add a statement up top that *some* form of egress is required, and that fully-private requires endpoints + private DNS?

Kira Thompson (author): Added a “Connectivity requirements” section at the top clarifying: (a) installer/cluster needs access to AWS APIs + registries; (b) either NAT or endpoints; (c) for no-internet environments you must configure endpoints + Private DNS. Also linked to troubleshooting.

Sean Gallagher (review): For the preflight error copy: please include the service name(s) and a copy/paste-friendly example (e.g., `com.amazonaws.<region>.ecr.api`). Even if we don’t create endpoints, naming them helps support.

Kira Thompson (author): Done. Error now prints the missing endpoint DNS names and points to the docs section with the full list. I kept it short to avoid noisy output, but included the exact identifiers.

Marcus Lin (security review): Doc currently suggests CloudWatch Logs endpoint “if log shipping”. Can we also mention that customers may route flow logs to S3 and that logs should remain in customer-owned accounts/buckets by default? Otherwise it reads like we require CWL.

Kira Thompson (author): Updated wording: CloudWatch Logs endpoint is optional and only needed if the customer chooses that sink; also added a note that logging destinations are customer-owned by default and that S3 is common for regulated setups.
Markus Klein (SE): +1. Please add a quick “If you see image pull failures” callout that directly ties to missing ECR endpoints + private DNS. That’s the #1 POC derailment.
Kira Thompson (author): Added a boxed callout at the top of troubleshooting with the image pull symptom + what to check first (ECR endpoints, Private DNS, resolver).
CI Bot: Tests failed: docs-link-check (2 broken links).
Kira Thompson (author): Fixed the broken links (wrong relative path in nav + typo in heading anchor). Re-ran CI.
CI Bot: All checks passed (unit, lint, docs-link-check).
Sean Gallagher (approval): Looks good. Messaging improvements will save us time in support.
Victor Alvarez (approval): Ship it. Endpoint/DNS guidance matches what we’ve been telling pilots.
Marcus Lin (approval): Approved with the logging wording updates.
